The whole public left-regular companion supplies only its exact own-source definitions.

All original namespaces, open Module, r/F variables, exact historical Galois import and Mathlib.ToLin remain intact. Pointwise Boolean AND, ordinary GF2 matrix multiplication and model-indexed extension-field multiplication are not identified. Field structure belongs to the regular image; the whole matrix ring is not asserted to be a field. Inverse conclusion retains a≠0.
